Author: Abelsson
Name: GlassChat
Description:
GlassChat is a fork of Chat 2, a complete rewrite of the in-game chat window as a plugin.
It adds:

- A real glass window background, with themes
- Minimising the chat to just its input bar, with new messages shown briefly above it
- A resize grip in the top-right corner

And keeps everything from Chat 2:

- Unlimited tabs
- Tabs that always send to a certain channel
- More flexible filtering
- RGB channel colouring
- Completely variable font size
- Sidebar tabs
- Unread counts
- Emotes
- Screenshot mode (obfuscate names)
Punchline: A complete replacement for the in-game chat, on real glass.
Changelog:
0.1.2
- Fixed: the chat no longer bounces when you minimise or expand it with the arrow button. This fix was meant for 0.1.1 but missed the release.

0.1.1
New
- Import your settings from Chat 2: Settings > GlassChat > Chat 2, then hold Ctrl and Shift and click Import. Your glass and chat bar settings are kept.
- Select chat text by clicking and dragging over it, then copy it with Ctrl+C.

Fixes
- The minimised chat no longer bounces when new messages appear, or when you minimise and expand it.

Changes
- Dragging on the message log now selects text instead of moving the chat window. Move the window by its tab bar or edges.
